The present petition has been preferred for the Patna High Court CWJC No.17117 of 2017(3)
dt.02-12-2025 following relief/s:
(i) for a Direction upon the Respondents to make Revaluation of the acquired building/structure of the Petitioner as per the details of land mentioned at Para, 4 of the present application by initiating a fresh enquiry after constituting a committee;
(ii) for a Direction upon the Respondents to act upon in accordance with Section 26 of the New Land Acquisition Act as also under Section 20 (Ch) of the Railways (Amendment) Act 2008 and accordingly the value of the structure/house be assess/
fix on the basis of current market rate in comparison with the rate of District Registration Office;
(iii) for a Direction upon the Respondents not to apply method/tactics of price depreciation in case of assessment of the valuation of building/structure;
(iv) for a Direction upon the Respondents to pay the Solatium amount in case of soil Patna High Court CWJC No.17117 of 2017(3) dt.02-12-2025 filling, tree and it's ancillary relating to the land of the Petitioner along with a Compensation @12% on annual basis be given to the Petitioner;
(v) for a Direction upon the Respondents to make the valuation/fixation of the rate of land, building/structure together afresh in terms of Section 24 (2) of the New Land Acquisition Act, 2013;
(vi) for a Direction upon the Respondents not to act upon further till the grievances of the Petitioner as stated above be not redress/fully complied with and till then the Award prepared in this case as also the Order dated 19.5.2017, passed in ArbitrationCase No. 16/2016, passed by the Commissioner, Patna Division Patna (Respondent No. 6) may kindly be kept in abeyance;
(vii) further the Petitioner seeks indulgence of this Hon'ble Court to grant any other relief's for which the Petitioner is found Patna High Court CWJC No.17117 of 2017(3)
dt.02-12-2025 entitled in the facts and circumstances of this case.
